rules.name: eventContextGtOneCheckRule
rules.label: Context Check Decision - Greater than One

textTemplates.description: text template for when multiple records are records found
textTemplates.name: multipleRecordsFoundTextTemplate
textTemplates.text:
Hello {!OrganizationName} Admin,
The Device Monitoring System process is configured to start when a LiFeKinnex Event platform event message occurs. A LiFeKinnex Event message occurred, but the process didn't start because multiple records in your org match the values specified in the process's Object node.
Here are the values from the LiFeKinnex Event message. Serial Number: {!myVariable_myEvent.Serial_Number__c}
To fix this issue, adjust the matching filters in the process's Object node.
Thank you, Salesforce Process Automation
